title: The Ice Cream Van Came At 3AM #shorts #horror
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Imagine you hear the ice cream van song. At three a.m.
It's parked under the only street lamp. Lights on. Window open.
The man inside smiles. Too wide. "What flavour, buddy?"
The menu has one flavour you've never seen. "Your Favourite Memory."
"That one's free," he says. You laugh and take it.
It tastes like your seventh birthday. Like Grandma's kitchen.
In the morning, Mum shows you a photo. You, blowing out candles.
You don't remember it. Not the cake. Not the party. Nothing.
*Then you look closer. Grandma isn't in the photo anymore. Just an empty chair.
Outside, very softly, the ice cream song starts again.
And the man is calling your name. "Ready for seconds?"
